purpose: Audit data sufficiency for a trustworthy configuration-decision evaluation before any decision-policy training.
reason: The verified IMPRESSION-004 end-to-end config outcomes and IMPRESSION-005 A/B/C decisions all come from one objective family. Other repository curricula are task examples, not measured end-to-end outcomes for each configuration. Assigning them as decision labels would fabricate evidence.

verified_failures.note: Persistence and numerical-path failures are recorded with their failure mode; they are not treated as measured candidate quality outcomes unless the failure is attributable to that configuration under a matched workload.

rules: All examples from a workload family stay together in exactly one split.
Actual live telemetry and counterfactual safety challenges have distinct snapshot_kind values and are never pooled as hardware measurements.
Successful and failed attempts remain separate; failures without comparable objective results do not become numeric loss or latency labels.
Do not train a native decision adapter until at least three independent measured workload families support nonempty train, validation, and test splits.
test_reason: No pre-existing verified candidate family can serve as an unseen test because it informed the prior IMPRESSION-004 optimization and IMPRESSION-005 evaluation.
